title: DRIVECLUB

names.1: You Only Get One First Time

notes: For the DRIVECLUB PC recompilation (driveclub-recomp). The game still decides when you've earned a trophy; the recomp writes each one to its log (logs\driveclub_<date>.log), and Vault reads that log and never touches the game.
Vault finds the driveclub-recomp folder on your drives by itself. If it doesn't show up, click Add a game and pick DriveClub.exe in that folder.
The recomp doesn't remember trophies between launches, so Vault keeps them for you. #UniteInSpeed unlocks once you have every other main-game trophy, like the platinum on PlayStation.
The Tour and series trophies (the add-on events) are numbered from public trophy lists and haven't been confirmed in a game yet.

testGuide.title: Find the game
testGuide.detail: Start Vault and give it a minute: DRIVECLUB should appear in your library by itself. If it doesn't, click Add a game and choose DriveClub.exe in your driveclub-recomp folder.

testGuide.title: Finish an event
testGuide.detail: Play your first Tour event to the results screen. "You Only Get One First Time" should pop up within a few seconds of the game awarding it, and Last trophy should show its name.
